mapper.select: select se1.evaluate_id, se1.evaluate_message, se1.create_time, se1.evaluate_img, se1.satisfaction_flag, se1.user_id, g.good_title as goodsTitle,tu.user_name as userName,tu.avatar as avatar from sys_evaluate se1 LEFT JOIN tb_orders to1 ON se1.indent_number = to1.order_num LEFT JOIN goods g on to1.good_id = g.good_id LEFT JOIN tb_user tu on tu.user_id = to1.seller_id where se1.is_delete = 0 and to1.retrieve_type = 0 and to1.is_evaluate = 1 and se1.feedback_status = 1 order by se1.create_time desc

select se.*, tu.avatar as avatar, tu.user_name as userName from sys_evaluate se LEFT JOIN tb_orders to1 ON se.indent_number = to1.order_num LEFT JOIN tb_user tu on se.user_id = tu.user_id where se.is_delete = 0 and se.feedback_status = 1 and to1.is_evaluate = 1 and to1.order_number = #{params.indentNumber}
limit #{params.page},#{params.limit}

select se.*, g.title as title,tu.user_name as userName,tu.avatar as avatar from sys_evaluate se LEFT JOIN orders to1 ON se.indent_number = to1.order_num LEFT JOIN goods g on to1.goods_id = g.id LEFT JOIN tb_user tu on tu.user_id = se.user_id where se.is_delete = 0
and se.evaluate_message like concat('%',#{sysEvaluate.evaluateMessage},'%')
and se.satisfaction_flag = #{sysEvaluate.satisfactionFlag}
and tu.user_name like concat('%',#{sysEvaluate.userName},'%')
and g.good_title like concat('%',#{sysEvaluate.goodsTitle},'%')
and se.indent_number like concat('%',#{sysEvaluate.indentNumber},'%')
order by se.create_time desc

select se.*, g.title as title,tu.user_name as userName,tu.avatar as avatar from sys_evaluate se LEFT JOIN orders to1 ON se.indent_number = to1.order_num LEFT JOIN goods g on to1.goods_id = g.id LEFT JOIN tb_user tu on tu.user_id = se.user_id where se.is_delete = 0
and se.evaluate_message like concat('%',#{sysEvaluate.evaluateMessage},'%')
and se.satisfaction_flag = #{sysEvaluate.satisfactionFlag}
and g.id = #{sysEvaluate.goodId}
and tu.user_name like concat('%',#{sysEvaluate.userName},'%')
and g.good_title like concat('%',#{sysEvaluate.goodsTitle},'%')
and se.indent_number like concat('%',#{sysEvaluate.indentNumber},'%')
order by se.create_time desc

select se.evaluate_id,se.user_id,se.indent_number, se.evaluate_message,se.satisfaction_flag,se.create_time, se.evaluate_img,se.is_delete, tu.avatar as avatar, tu.user_name as userName from sys_evaluate se LEFT JOIN tb_orders to1 ON se.indent_number = to1.order_num LEFT JOIN tb_user tu on se.user_id = tu.user_id LEFT JOIN tb_user tu1 on to1.buyer_id = tu1.user_id where se.is_delete = 0 and se.feedback_status = 1 and to1.is_evaluate = 1 and se.recycle_status = 0 and se.user_id = #{params.userId} and to1.seller_id = #{params.byUserId}
limit #{params.page},#{params.limit}

select se.evaluate_id,se.user_id,se.indent_number, se.evaluate_message,se.satisfaction_flag,se.create_time, se.evaluate_img,se.is_delete, tu.avatar as avatar, tu.user_name as userName from sys_evaluate se LEFT JOIN tb_orders to1 ON se.indent_number = to1.order_num LEFT JOIN tb_user tu on se.user_id = tu.user_id where se.is_delete = 0 and se.feedback_status = 1 and to1.is_evaluate = 1 and se.recycle_status = 0 and se.user_id = #{byUserId}

select se.*, g.good_title as goodsTitle,tu.user_name as userName,tu.avatar as avatar from sys_evaluate se LEFT JOIN tb_orders to1 ON se.indent_number = to1.order_num LEFT JOIN goods g on to1.good_id = g.good_id LEFT JOIN tb_user tu on tu.user_id = se.user_id where se.is_delete = 0 and se.recycle_status = 1
and se.evaluate_message like concat('%',#{sysEvaluate.evaluateMessage},'%')
and se.satisfaction_flag = #{sysEvaluate.satisfactionFlag}
and tu.user_name like concat('%',#{sysEvaluate.userName},'%')
and g.good_title like concat('%',#{sysEvaluate.goodsTitle},'%')
and se.indent_number like concat('%',#{sysEvaluate.indentNumber},'%')
order by se.create_time desc
